raw_html: [[Medusa Fury|Medusa Fury]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Medusa Fury]]:''' When you fall below 25% of your maximum hit points you will enter a constant Medusa Fury until your hit points return to 25% or greater. Medusa Fury grants a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution, a 5% morale bonus to your chance to doublestrike, and a -25% penalty to fortifications.
